pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygons with jagged, leaf-like margins and moderate edge-blur due to hair texture. Patches on the mid-flank are larger in area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and consistent across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous mane is visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette composed of vertical hair clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical skin fold is visible at the junction of the shoulder and the anterior flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian subject (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge near the base of the neck.
